articles.title: Bank Of England Holds Key Rate In 6-3 MPC Split
articles.expand: The Bank of England maintained its interest rate in a split vote as renewed tensions in the Middle East reignited fears of high inflation becoming persistent. The Monetary Policy Committee, led by Governor Andrew Bailey, voted 6-3 to hold the bank rate at 3.75 percent, which is the lowest rate since June 2023. Previously, the central bank had reduced the rate by 25 basis points each in August.

articles.title: German GDP Growth Beats Expectations
articles.expand: Germany's economy grew 0.2% in Q2, surpassing forecasts amid strong export performance. Year-on-year calendar-adjusted growth accelerated to 0.9% from expected 0.6% slowdown. According to provisional data, exports expanded from the first quarter. Final consumption expenditure showed a subdued trend, while capital formation declined in the second quarter.

articles.title: Australia Inflation Slows To 4-Month Low
articles.expand: Australia's consumer price inflation slowed to a four-month low in June on lower fuel prices and underlying inflation remained stable, easing pressure on the central bank for further policy tightening.
